user.title: Connect to Eversports
user.description: Enter the details for the facility and sport you want to monitor. You can find these in the URL and network traffic of the Eversports widget.

abort.already_configured: This facility and sport combination is already configured.

data_fetch_failed.title: Eversports data fetch failed for {sport}
data_fetch_failed.description: Eversports data fetch for {sport} at facility {facility_id} has failed for more than 24 hours. This likely means the website layout or API has changed. Please check if there is an update or open a GitHub issue if none exists.
